title: Blockade Robot
description: CLASSIC VIDEO GAME FOR TWO, in the disk menu's words. 2 recovered forms; the disk form plays.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: TWO PLAYER TRAIL GAME
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, exact length and end marker; exact independent left/right payload match; disputed bit examined in both channels
versions.unavailableReason: Earlier save, kept as source. The site plays the later form from the Games Diskette (v02).

versions.label: Blockade Robot (Games Diskette)
versions.note: Complete disk file BLOCKRB.BAS (directory size, ordered records, consistent pointers, end marker). Runs under NEWDOS/80 Disk BASIC from the original disk image; the disk's menu starts it, and it can return there. Runtime limited to the startup check.
